# Side by Side Therapy Connect
Website: https://sidebysidetherapyconnect.ca
Corporate Name: Side by Side Therapy Inc.
Service Model: Specialized In-Home Clinical Connection & Matching Platform
Location: Ontario, Canada (In-Home Service Delivery)

## Core Mission & Positioning
Side by Side Therapy Connect bridges families of children with Autism Spectrum Disorder (ASD) to vetted, autonomous in-home therapy teams across Ontario. We facilitate direct, transparent connections rather than acting as a traditional bureaucratic agency.

## Clinical Team Composition
Every connected team consists of:
1. Instructor Therapist (IT): Delivers direct 1-on-1 assent-based, play-informed intervention in the child's home.
2. Supervising Registered Behaviour Analyst (R.B.A. Ont.): Licensed by the College of Psychologists and Behaviour Analysts of Ontario (CPBAO). Directly designs, monitors, and evaluates the Behaviour Service Plan (BSP).

## Regulatory Standards
- Full compliance with the Psychology and Applied Behaviour Analysis Act, 2021.
- Mandatory CPBAO Standard 4.4 Written Supervision Agreements for 100% of caseloads.
- Zero tiered supervision (Standard 4.9). Unregulated individuals never supervise therapists.
- Ontario Personal Health Information Protection Act, 2004 (PHIPA) compliant electronic records.

## Funding Compatibility
- Ontario Autism Program (OAP) Core Clinical Services
- OAP Childhood Budgets & Interim One-Time Funding
- Private Extended Health Insurance (Psychology / RBA coverage)
